# ASE Technologies

> ASE Technologies is a digital marketing and software company based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. It provides SEO, search engine marketing, social media marketing, content marketing, website design and development, graphic design, custom SaaS applications and AI WhatsApp automation.

The company serves businesses in Visakhapatnam, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Vijayawada.

## Core services

- [Digital Marketing](https://asetechnologies.in/digital-marketing.html): Integrated digital marketing, search, paid media, social and answer-engine strategies.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://asetechnologies.in/search-engine-optimization.html): Technical SEO, local SEO, content optimization and organic visibility.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://asetechnologies.in/social-media-marketing.html): Social content, community management and paid social campaigns.
- [Content Marketing](https://asetechnologies.in/content-marketing.html): Editorial strategy, writing and content distribution.
- [Website Designing](https://asetechnologies.in/website-designing.html): Responsive, accessible business websites and web applications.
- [Graphic Designing](https://asetechnologies.in/graphic-designing.html): Brand identity and visual campaign assets.
- [SaaS Products](https://asetechnologies.in/saas-products.html): Eswari Connects for real-estate teams and SmartEduConnect for schools.
